correctness.rationale: For exactly nine affine points, an exhaustive 79-pair acyclic Morse matching and an integral unit cycle–cocycle witness prove the prerequisite wedge \(S^2\vee\bigvee^{11}S^3\). Every one of 432 distinct affine transformations is enumerated and preserves the twelve lines; exact oriented chain traces and Lefschetz yield the complete \(H_3\) character. The integral \(H_2\) action equals the determinant sign by directly pairing the moved primitive generator with the integer cocycle. Both character averages are exactly zero; barycentric quotient and rational finite-group averaging give reduced rational acyclicity. Standalone final code reruns all finite checks and terminates VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: This determines a natural missing homological symmetry invariant of the unique order-nine Steiner triple system. Its 432-element character is not determined by previously known Betti numbers or wedge-of-spheres homotopy and it yields a substantive quotient-space theorem: all reduced rational homology vanishes despite nontrivial \(H_2\) and \(H_3\) upstairs. The exact determinant sign and ten profiles are reproducible from a short standalone finite calculation; the scope and open integral quotient questions are explicit.
